import { Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import Home from './pages/Home'
import SaibaMais from './pages/Saiba'
import HiokiSushi from './pages/Prato/HiokiSushi'
import LaDolceVita from './pages/Prato/LaDolceVita'
import Diablo from './pages/Prato/Diablo'
import StarWars from './pages/Prato/StarWars'

const Rotas = () => {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
      <Route path="/saiba-mais" element={<SaibaMais />} />
      <Route path="/prato/hioki-sushi" element={<HiokiSushi />} />
      <Route path="/prato/la-dolce-vita" element={<LaDolceVita />} />
      <Route path="/prato/diablo" element={<Diablo />} />
      <Route path="/prato/star-wars" element={<StarWars />} />
    </Routes>
  )
}

export default Rotas
